text.description_html:
Emtek 86156, Lost Wax Bronze Tuscany Column Door Pull

The Column Lost Wax Door Handle features the Earthy hues and rustic look that is characteristic of Tuscan decor. The Lost Wax Bronze Tuscany Column Door Pull is available in either flat black or medium bronze finishes. The decorative finials grant this old world door handle a historic look that harkens to Mediterranean classic decor. The Tuscany Column Door Pull comes packaged with the necessary mounting hardware to thru-bolt it on a door up to 1-3/4 inches thick.

Thru-Bolted Mounting: Pull bolts through the door.

Also Available: Column Pull with Back-to-Back Mounting

Specifications of the Emtek Tuscany Column Lost Wax Cast Bronze Pull:

  • Material: Lost Wax Cast Bronze
  • Center to Center Length: 8" (c.c.)
  • Total Length: 11"
  • Pull Handle Width: 13/16"
  • Total Projection: 3"
  • Base: 1-1/4" square
  • Door Thickness: for doors up to 1-3/4" thick
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.
  • Comes packaged with (2) 1" long 1/4"-20 screws, (2) 1" long #10-32 screws, (2) 2" #10-32 screws, and (2) screw caps.

Sold individually with thru-bolt mounting.
